fact: The Daily Monitor reported on 9 October 2026 that the Uganda Civil Aviation Authority runs Entebbe airport car parks on entervo V3 with AI and machine-learning number-plate recognition, installed by Samanga Utilities Limited, per UCAA's Vianney Luggya.
Minister Kasule Lumumba said the Uganda Communications Commission is in the process of procuring an AI-powered system to identify and filter harmful content; cost, vendor and date were not disclosed.
system: UCC AI content filtering system (being procured)

fact: The Uganda Police Force says it is set to introduce an AI-powered chatbot for public access to police services, and an officer demonstrated how the public will use it, but it is not yet launched and will be rolled out in different parts of the country.
